package.name: vi_global_planner
package.description:
Value-iteration global planner for Nav2: a Rust node that serves the compute_path_to_pose action (nav2_msgs) by solving the vi_rs value iteration on the static map and rolling out the optimal policy into a nav_msgs/Path. Drop-in replacement for nav2_planner's planner_server.
Global planning only — pair it with nav2_controller's controller_server. Unlike vi_planner (which serves compute_path_to_pose and follow_path from one value function), this node supports map_scale and the out-of-core (compact) solver, so it is the one to use for maps too large to solve densely.
